questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: Q1: My grandmother doesn’t know how to use the computer. Your solutions
questions.sample_answer: You should guide her step by step through basic computer operations, such as surfing the Internet, playing music, or watching videos on YouTube. A simple and patient approach will make her feel more confident.

questions.prompt: The last time you used your computer. Your purpose.
questions.sample_answer:
I used my computer yesterday to watch my favorite movie, Queen of Tears. It was a fantastic experience, and I enjoyed every moment of it.


Or
The last time I used my computer was 4 hours ago. I reviewed some basic knowledge for an upcoming exam and checked the schedule carefully. Afterward, I listened to an English song to relax and refresh my mind.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, people use computers a lot. This is not good. Your opinion
questions.sample_answer:
While computers bring many benefits, overusing them can lead to reduced physical activity and social interaction, which is harmful. Striking a balance is essential for a healthier lifestyle.
 
or
It’s clear that using computers a lot is not good. It makes us depend on computers deeply. Sitting in front of them for several hours can also affect our eye health.
